Global migratory bird populations show significant decline, study finds

A recent global study indicates that 51% of migratory bird species are experiencing declining populations. The research highlights the widespread nature of this environmental concern, prompting questions about potential conservation efforts. This finding underscores the significant impact of environmental changes on biodiversity.
